column1: # The closed list of what the regression harness (fork issue #119) counts as out of scope. This file is the only place that says
# so, and a change to it goes through a pull request. Everything else that the postgresql language cannot do is refused.
# The reasons are the three of the issue:
#   1  PostgreSQL itself answers differently in two runs on two fresh databases (now(), random(), object ids)
#   2  the statement shows PostgreSQL internals that the language does not model: EXPLAIN plan text, pg_catalog, and system
#   3  the statement administers the PostgreSQL server: tablespaces, replication, and server-side C code
#   id       names the entry in the results, each has its own count
#   pattern  a regular expression on the statement in one line (words in lower case, one blank between tokens, every string
#            as '?' except the one after "language"), or:
#              @catalog-relation  a word of the statement is the name of a table or view of pg_catalog on the server
#              @server-function   the statement calls a function that a statement before it defined with server-side C code
#              @two-runs          measured, never matched: the two runs of PostgreSQL answered differently
#   why      the reason in words, as it stands in the results
# The first entry that matches a statement counts.
